review_notes: I read the whole file. I also read `roots`/`eps` in OrthogonalSplitRootData.lean and grepped for uses of `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt`, `coordWt_sub_mem_roots` and `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots`. I did not run Lean, so the proposed rewrite is untested. The best repeated-machinery candidate is the four-way case split of `α ∈ roots r` into coordinate pairs (a,b). `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots` and `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt` both do it, with the same witnesses and the same `coordWt_inl`/`coordWt_inr` normalisations. The 8-case `coordWt_sub_mem_roots` is the converse direction of the same case table, so merging it would save little, and I did not report it. Other proofs (`coordWt_injective`, `eq_or_eq_of_coordWt_sub_eq`, `autMat_rpElt`, `rpElt_swap_swap`) share little reasoning with one another. The finding is modest: it removes about 10 lines and one duplicated case table, and the move needs a field (ℚ) as a dummy parameter.

findings.problem: `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots` splits `α ∈ roots r` into its four cases and, in each, picks the coordinate pair that `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt` (line 167) picks: (inl i, inl j), (inl j, inl i), (inl i, inr j), (inr j, inl i). It then reshapes `coordWt a - coordWt b` into the `eps` form with a different `simp only ... ; rwa` incantation per case (`neg_add_eq_sub`, `sub_neg_eq_add`). `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt` repeats the same split, witnesses and `coordWt_inl, coordWt_inr; abel` normalisations. The mapping from root shapes to coordinate pairs is therefore written twice, and the four ad hoc rewrites at 79–87 each replace one `abel` already present at 168–190.
findings.proposed_change: Prove `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots` from the representation already provided by `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt`, and delete its own case analysis. Move it (and `dotProduct_eq_neg_one_of_add_mem_roots` and `zero_notMem_roots`, which depend on it) after `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt`, or put the witness choice into a small lemma used by both. The proof becomes `obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl, -⟩ := exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt (K := ℚ) hα; exact coordWt_sub_dotProduct_self hab`. The lemma has no field parameter, so ℚ is used as a dummy field. If that is unwanted, factor out `exists_coordWt_sub_eq_of_mem_roots : α ∈ roots r → ∃ a b, coordIdx a ≠ coordIdx b ∧ coordWt a - coordWt b = α`. The 4-case proof of that lemma can be `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt`'s witness part, and `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots` then follows from `coordWt_sub_dotProduct_self` directly. `exists_rootElt_eq_rpElt` would still need its own per-case `rootElt` rewrites.
findings.benefit: The mapping from the four root shapes to coordinate pairs is stated once, so a change to the `roots` or `coordWt` conventions is maintained in one place. About ten lines of case-specific `simp only`/`rwa` rewriting go, and `dotProduct_self_of_mem_roots` becomes a one-line corollary of the pair lemma `coordWt_sub_dotProduct_self`.
